random.definition: all other fact answers; seed-0 random draw labelled

hand_upper_bound_two_sided_95.formula: (census hand_propagated + p_upper_two_sided_95_clopper_pearson x random population) / fact_answers
hand_upper_bound_two_sided_95.note: Published bound. Chosen because it is the more conservative: the labelled random-sample answers are treated as uncertain too.

sensitivity_upper_bound_treating_18_labe.formula: (census hand_propagated + random hand_propagated + p_upper_two_sided_95_clopper_pearson x random not_sampled) / fact_answers
